name: Chatham Bars Inn
positioning: Historic oceanfront resort in Chatham on Cape Cod, centered on a Main Inn first built in 1914, with its own private beach, boat fleet and farm
best_for: Families wanting a beach resort with a kids program and a heated oceanfront pool
Travelers who want boat trips from an on-site private dock, including charters to Nantucket and Martha's Vineyard
Food-minded travelers drawn to farm-to-table and clambake dining

facts.text: The resort is just moments from Chatham's Main Street boutiques, galleries and restaurants.
The Main Inn was built long before modern zoning, and its setting could not be recreated today.
Ocean View Rooms are on the second and third floors of the Main Inn, each with a deck or balcony overlooking Chatham Harbor and the Atlantic Ocean.
The cottage-style rooms are spread across the grounds; many have private decks or balconies and select rooms have a gas fireplace.
The Spa Suites have oversized hydrotherapy tubs, saunas, steam showers and fireplaces.
The resort does not charge resort fees.
Beach House Grill sits in the sand dunes of Chatham Harbor and serves clambake classics, clam chowder, lobster rolls and salads from the resort's farm.
The Veranda overlooks Chatham Harbor, with Mediterranean menus given a Cape Cod flair.
In the cooler fall months, the farm-to-table dinners move indoors to the farm's glass greenhouses.
Private boat charters include island trips to Nantucket and Martha's Vineyard.
For families there is the Kids Crew program and an oceanfront heated pool.

highlights.text: The resort has its own boat fleet, captained by U.S. Coast Guard-licensed crew and departing from an on-site private dock.
The 8-acre Chatham Bars Inn Farm in nearby Brewster grows 125 varieties of vegetables, using techniques including hydroponics.
The Main Inn was first built in 1914 and has been restored.
The South Lounge is anchored by a restored antique Brunswick San Domingo bar from about 1880.
Private beach clambakes come with a private bonfire and a chef-led clambake.

considerations.text: The Chatham Bars Inn Farm is in nearby Brewster, so farm visits and farm dinners are off the resort grounds.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the resort's exclusive positioning.
